description: This file defines the MemoryStreamBufferWriter struct, which implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface for writing byte data to a MemoryStream, including methods for advancing the stream position and providing memory/span buffers with size hints.

classes.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: Implements IBufferWriter<byte> to facilitate writing bytes to a MemoryStream with size hinting and buffer management.

methods.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer writer with a given MemoryStream.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position in the stream by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> buffer with at least sizeHint capacity, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> buffer with at least sizeHint capacity, resizing if necessary.
